Card Q&A.a: Yes, they get -2000 DP even when checked by some other Digimon than the one that has this in its digivolution cards.
Card Q&A.q: While this card is in the digivolution cards of a Digimon with [Shoutmon] in its name, do my opponent's Security Digimon get -2000 DP from this card's inherited effect even when they are checked by some other Digimon?

Effect: [On Play] If you have another Digimon or Tamer with [Xros Heart] in its traits in play, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP until the end of your opponent's turn.
[On Deletion] ＜Save＞ (You may place this card under one of your Tamers.)
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has [Shoutmon] in its name, all of your opponent's Security Digimon get -2000 DP.
Special Digivolution Condition: [Digivolve] 2 from Lv.3 w/[Xros Heart] in traits
